messages:
infra_bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate from az1a (rolling 5m error rate 14%, tail latency jitter > 300ms). Auto-page sent to oncall.
jamie_sre: I got the pager, investigating :eyes: starting with target group health checks + host metrics.
tara_runtime: seeing grpc 502s from model-hosts in az1a, KCACHE queues high, CPU ok. logs: `rpc: send failed: write: connection reset by peer`
jamie_sre: running quick checks — `sudo tc -s qdisc show dev eth0` shows tx-queue drops and qdisc backlog spikes. ELB target health: several hosts flapping Unhealthy->Healthy.
eva_eng: adding context — we deployed a small infra tweak 30m ago that changed conn reuse limits, but it passed staging.
jamie_sre: confirming, kernel tx_skb_drop and softirq backlog rising. hypothesis: host-side network TX stall causing intermittent 5xx health checks.
omar_pm: customer impact? any major tenants affected?
kate_support: CS: ~12 customers opened tickets noting high latency and intermittent errors, 2 escalations (high-traffic RTA apps).
jamie_sre: mitigation plan: 1) remove flapping targets from TG to stop unhealthy cycling 2) shift 25% of inference traffic from az1a -> az1b/eu1 for the next 15m 3) scale up spare capacity in az1b.
tara_runtime: also recommend routing model-serving to the quantized model variant for spill traffic to keep latency down.
jamie_sre: executing step 1 now — `aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:... --targets Id=i-0abc123` (doing in small batches).
deploy_bot: Deploy event: manual deregistration initiated by jamie_sre at 4559000105.
jamie_sre: step 2 traffic steer in progress — adding a traffic-split rule: `routeset inference-route: prefer az1b, weight az1a=75 az1b=25`
eva_eng: monitoring KV cache warmup for spill; expect a small latency bump during resharding.
jamie_sre: observed immediate drop in 5xx to ~3% after first batch removed. continuing incremental removal.
tara_runtime: advise to keep a subset of healthy hosts in az1a for customer locality-sensitive workloads.
kate_support: drafting customer note for impacted tenants — ETA for full mitigation?
jamie_sre: ETA ~20-30m to stabilize, will update in 10.
omar_pm: please flag any customers needing proactive outreach. I'll coordinate comms if severity rises.
jamie_sre: follow-up: metrics show kernel tx backpressure continuing on a minority of hosts — plan B is to drain and reprovision affected instances (ephemeral replacement). Scheduling drains now.
jamie_sre: handoff to night oncall at 4559012000 — @tara_runtime please take post-mitigation watch and confirm latencies stable. Leaving runbook notes and commands used.
tara_runtime: ack, taking over :thumbsup: I'll keep traffic split for 30m and then gradually revert if stable.
kate_support: sent interim customer updates to escalations, included workaround (route to cross-az) and ETA.
jamie_sre: postmortem owner assigned: jamie_sre. Potential causes to investigate: kernel qdisc regression + unexpected conn-reuse interaction with ELB health checks.
infra_bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: error rate returning to baseline (2xx 96%) at 4559013500. Monitoring continues.
omar_pm: great work team — please capture timeline and action items for RCA. Closing paging loop for now. :wave:
